verdict.rationale: Muse lets users scope what the agent can access: you choose what it can see and do across connected apps, review the permissions you've approved, and approve actions before they happen. It also keeps saved logins in a credential store the agent can't see and issues one-time card numbers at checkout, a form of single-use, least-privilege credential. However, there is no evidence of issuing scoped API keys or tokens for an agent, and the probes found no public API or developer surface. Missing for 10: user-issued scoped/least-privilege API keys or tokens, documented per-credential scope/expiry/revocation controls, a developer API surface, independent corroboration.
